# Real export, SharePoint connection (sanitized)

Source: Import Package (Legacy) export from the PFM's tenant, 2026-11-11 15:53 UTC. One flow: manual trigger, one SharePoint "Get items" action.
Sent as email text, so file names were retyped: the folder path is assumed to be Microsoft.Flow/flows/<asset id>/ and the map file apisMap.json (the email said "manifest.json\\<id>" and "apiaMap.json").

Sanitized: every GUID, the tenant, user, site URL, list ID, connection name and the connection's display name (an email address) replaced with fake values. Relationships between IDs are kept. Structure, keys, key order and all other values are unchanged.
